title: Strands Agents、LeRobot 与 Hugging Face 存储桶：一站式记录、训练与部署机器人智能体
summary: 本文介绍了如何利用 Strands Agents、LeRobot 和 Hugging Face Storage Buckets 构建一个从数据记录到模型训练再到部署的完整闭环，旨在简化机器人学习工作流。Strands Agents 作为数据采集与执行平台，能够高效记录机器人操作数据；LeRobot 是 Hugging Face 推出的开源机器人学习框架，支持从真实或仿真数据中训练策略模型；Hugging Face Storage Buckets 则提供可扩展的云存储，用于安全存储和版本管理大规模数据集。三者集成后，用户可以在统一环境中完成数据采集、预处理、模型训练、评估和部署，显著降低机器人应用开发的复杂度和成本。文章还展示了具体的技术架构和代码示例，强调了数据流的高效性和可重复性，并讨论了该方案在工业自动化、科研实验等场景中的潜在应用。整体而言，该方案推动了机器人学习领域的标准化和民主化，使开发者能够更便捷地构建智能机器人系统。
summary_en: This article introduces an integrated workflow using Strands Agents, LeRobot, and Hugging Face Storage Buckets to streamline the entire robot learning pipeline from data recording to model training and deployment. Strands Agents handles data collection and execution, LeRobot provides an open-source framework for training policies from real or simulated data, and Hugging Face Storage Buckets offers scalable cloud storage for managing large datasets. The integration enables users to perform data acquisition, preprocessing, training, evaluation, and deployment in one place, significantly reducing complexity and cost. The article includes technical architecture and code examples, highlighting efficiency and reproducibility, and discusses applications in industrial automation and research. This approach promotes standardization and democratization in robot learning, making it easier for developers to build intelligent robotic systems.
